critic_suggestions: All plotted values match log Sec. 3 table 1 (shares recomputed: 72.3/13.3/7.3/6.6/0.4; 33.2/1.1/14.8/50.4/0.6; 10.0/0.0/14.0/76.0/0.0). Presentation: the Full-text partly/not-in-text segments (7% each) had no value labels; the right-hand annotation 'in text: 49%\nof missed' broke awkwardly across lines.

Rendered image was about 4.1 in wide because tight bbox added the legend and right annotations, so fonts would shrink below 8 pt at column width; the 7% in-segment labels were cramped. Moved n into the y tick labels, replaced the right annotations by one 'In text, share of missed' column, dropped the redundant y-axis title, switched to constrained layout with a figure legend. First re-render put the share column on top of the bar ends (x=103); moved it to x=108 inside an extended 0-115 range with the spine bounded at 100%.

Values unchanged and correct. The two 7% labels in the Full-text bar touched segment edges at 7 pt; removed labels for segments narrower than 9.5% (their sizes remain readable against the axis). Final render checked: no overlaps, no clipped text, no caption text inside the image, no project or author names.

Reviewer: labels too small in print. Redesigned at printed width with all text >= 7 pt; checked at print size: no overlap, no clipping. 2.4 x 2.3 in (beside fig_hidden_fulltext, same height). Access level and n on a line above each bar, 'in text: X% of missed' right-aligned on the same line. Legend labels shortened ('Missed, in text', 'Missed, partly in text', 'Missed, not in text').
